prompt_en: One unmistakably adult woman conducts a live accession audit in a sunlit brutalist seed-bank accession hall. Photorealistic vertical full-body editorial-documentary photograph, eye-level and near-frontal; she is the sole visible person and fills most of the frame from head to footwear. Use Image 1 only for facial and general appearance continuity, with long dark softly waved hair and understated natural makeup. She wears an original cold-shoulder top in fine rib knit with a calf-length midi skirt and cleanly visible waistband. the neckline remains continuous across the upper torso above both openings; two bounded shoulder-top cutouts are visible, one on each side; both sleeves remain attached below the cutouts and continue down the upper arms; finished seams bound every cutout edge, while fabric bridges connect neckline, bodice, and sleeves. an off-shoulder neckline does not substitute for bounded windows; the design reads as attached sleeves around two finished shoulder windows. Two tailored shoulder windows sit symmetrically between the unbroken upper bodice and the sleeves. Fine vertical ribbing widens subtly across the moving elbows and returns to even spacing over the relaxed torso. The complete outfit topology, neckline, both shoulders and sleeves, waist and closure or crotch and inseam region, legs, and hems must remain fully visible and readable in one vertical full-body frame. Her straight skirt line and full hem are unobscured. Her hands stay outside her torso silhouette: she holds the translucent accession packet below shoulder level and away from the neckline, both shoulder windows, and waistband, aligning its punched serial code with a low luminous bay number inside a lower branch of the clerestory sunbeam. A narrow brass counter and open archival drawer remain lateral. Warm sunlight cuts through cool gray concrete, grazing the finished bridges and revealing floating dust; stainless canisters recede in calibrated rows and a tiny mismatch marker completes the evidence.
negative_en: fake-looking background, plastic-looking skin, low resolution, 3D render look, body distortion, cartoon style, unrealistic hands
